integrity: The proof is finite-dimensional spectral analysis. A Python/SymPy exact-rational checker is included; computer instances supplement but do not replace the universal proof. No independent scientific validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the equal-population disease-free linearization; symmetric nonnegative mobility, equal nonhub infection rates, strictly positive uniform hub flux. No nonlinear synchrony or final-size theorem.
title: Sharp transverse homogenization under single-hub epidemic mobility
